integrity: A complete elementary proof and an independent direct-matrix exhaustive checker are included. The checker confirms three finite cases; no independent mathematical audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem covers the left-minus-right regular Jordan signature for nilpotent radical elements of the four-by-four triangular algebra, not a complete joint Jordan classification, arbitrary diagonal elements, or larger algebras. Historical priority against an undiscovered equivalent general result is not certified. Direct enumeration was performed only for three prime fields; proof covers all finite fields.
title: Seven-stratum two-sided Jordan asymmetry in the four-by-four triangular algebra
